description: Baugher: served the 60th FIS at Otis AFB then went to the Canadian Armed Forces as 101041 at Bangor with 416 and 425 Squadrons before returning to the USAF; reported on display at Maine ANG Bangor and painted as 57-0377. Aerial Visuals fixes it at 44.81743 -68.82140.

Baugher: served the 18th FIS then the Maine ANG 132nd FIS; was on display at Waterville Airport and is currently on display at Bangor IAP Dow ANG Base Maine. Aerial Visuals fixes it at 44.81826 -68.82158. This is the airframe Aerial Visuals notes was moved from Waterville in 2000.
